info.title: API.SH: Marktplaats
info.description: The Marktplaats API from API.SH: public Marktplaats data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
The search suggestions Marktplaats shows while typing, each with the category it points to and that category's parent (ids ready for the search endpoint's category and subcategory).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/marktplaats-autocomplete

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Suggestions within one category id (default 0 = all).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Marktplaats ad: price and price type, full description, every attribute, delivery and shipping, photos, location, posting date, views, favourites, bids and, for business sellers, the seller (name, type, years active, profile and all-ads links). Pass `url`, or `latest=1` with search params. Private sellers' names, phone numbers and email addresses are never returned (masked in ad text).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/marktplaats-listing

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: `1`: open the first current result of a search made with this route's search params (q, location and filters) instead of an id. Ads expire, so this keeps a link working.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Marktplaats (marktplaats.nl) classified ads for a keyword with category, postcode and distance, price, attribute filters (condition, delivery, brand...), offered-since and sort. Each result has price, attributes, photos, location and distance, date, traits and, for business sellers, the seller. `facets` lists attribute values with ids for `attribute_ids`, `categories` the category ids. Private sellers' names, phone numbers and email addresses are never returned (masked in ad text).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/marktplaats-search

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Top-level category id (445 Fietsen en Brommers, 91 Auto's, 31 Audio Tv en Foto, 820 Telecommunicatie); see `categories`.

parameters.name: distance_km
parameters.description: Radius in km around the postcode.

parameters.name: attribute_ids
parameters.description: Attribute value ids from `facets`, comma-separated (e.g. 30 = new, 31 = as good as new, 32 = used).

parameters.name: title_and_description
parameters.description: false: match keywords in titles only.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Results page, 1 for the first. Pass back `next_page`; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Marktplaats business seller and their ads
get.description:
A Marktplaats business seller's profile and active ads, 30 a page: seller id, name, profile link, website, verified flag, rating and review count, address and the price range of their ads; then each ad with id, link, title, description, price and price type, date, category ids, location with coordinates, photos, attributes, traits, priority, reserved and video flags. Private sellers answer 404.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/marktplaats-seller

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The seller id (seller.id in /marktplaats/v1/search and /marktplaats/v1/listing results).

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The seller's marktplaats.nl/u/<name>/<id>/ link instead of id.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The ads Marktplaats shows as similar under an ad: id, title, link, price, price type, image and whether it is a business ad.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/marktplaats-similar

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: An ad id (m1874848831) or a marktplaats.nl /v/... ad link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
